verses.en: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:
verses.sm: Afai lua te nonofo ma se alii e taumafa se “ava, seia e matuá mafaufau i mea ua i ou luma;

verses.en: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
verses.sm: ina e tuu atu se polo i lou ua, pe afai e te se tagata “ai tele;

verses.en: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
verses.sm: aua e te naunau i ana mea suamalie; aua o mea e “ai pepelo lava ia.

verses.en: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
verses.sm: Aua e te galue faapuapuaga ia mauoloa ai; tuu ia o lou lava taofi.

verses.en: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
verses.sm: E te tulimatai atu ea i le mea va leai? aua e faia lava e ia ona apaau; e pei o le aeto ona lele atu o ia i le lagi.

verses.en: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
verses.sm: Aua ete “ai i le mea e ‘ai a le mataoge; aua foi e te naunau i ana mea suamalie.

verses.en: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
verses.sm: Aua e pei ona manatu o ia i lona loto, ua faapea lava o ia; e fai mai o ia ia te oe, ‘Ai ia ma inu; a e le ia te oe lona loto.

verses.en: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
verses.sm: E te toe puai mai le fasi mea ua uma ona ‘ai, ma e faamaumau au upu malie.

verses.en: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
verses.sm: Aua e te tautala atu i taliga o le vale; auā e ʻinoʻino o ia i le poto o au upu.

verses.en: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
verses.sm: to Ana neʻi sii le tuaoi o le vavau; aua foi neʻi e wa fanua o e matuaoti.

verses.en: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
verses.sm: Aua e malosi lava lo latou Faaola; o ia lava na te faia la latou finauga ma oe.

verses.en: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.sm: Uai mai lou loto i mea e aʻoaʻoina, ma ou taliga i upu e poto ai.

verses.en: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
verses.sm: Aua neʻi taofia le aoaiga i le tama; aua afai e te sasa ia te ia i se laau, e le otio ia;

verses.en: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
verses.sm: E te sasa ia te ia i se laau, ona e laveaiina lea o lona agaga ai seoli.

verses.en: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
verses.sm: Lo'u atalii e, afai e poto lou loto, ona fiafia ai lea o loʻu nei lava loto;

verses.en: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
verses.sm: e olioli foi loʻu manatu, ve a tautala ou laugutu i mea ua tonu.

verses.en: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
verses.sm: Aua le losilosi lou loto i e agasala; a ia e mataʻu i le ALII i le aso atoa;

verses.en: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.sm: ana afai o i ai le iuga, ona le iuvale lea o lou faamoemoe.

verses.en: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
verses.sm: Ia e faalogo mai, loʻu atalii e, ma ia e poto; ma e ta‘ita‘i tonu lou loto i le ala.

verses.en: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
verses.sm: Aua neʻi fai oe ma so latou o e inu tele i uaina; ma e ua aai tetele i manu;

verses.en: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
verses.sm: aua o le inu tele ma ‘ai tele e faamativaina o ia; ma lè fia moe pea e ofu o ia i ofu masaesae.

verses.en: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
verses.sm: Ia e faalogo i lou tama, o le na fanaua oe; aua foi e te ‘ino‘ino i lou tinà pe a loomatua o ia.

verses.en: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
verses.sm: Ia e faatau mai le mea moni, aua lava le faatau atu; atoa foi ma le poto, ma le aʻoaʻoina, ma le atamai.

verses.en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
verses.sm: E matua olioli lava le tama o le ua amiotonu; O le na fanaua le atalii poto e fiafia o ia ia te ia;

verses.en: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
verses.sm: E fiafia lou tama ma lou tina; e olioli lava le na fanau mai oe.

verses.en: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
verses.sm: Lo'u atalii e, au mai ia lou loto ia te au; ma ia fiafia ou mata i oʻu ala.

verses.en: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
verses.sm: Aua o le fafine talitane, o le lua maulalo lea; o le fafine ese, o le vaieli pu itiiti lea;

verses.en: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
verses.sm: o ia foi na te saunia mailei, e tusa ma le ua fao mea, na te faatoateleina foi tagata amioletonu.

verses.en: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?
verses.sm: E ia te ai ea le aue? e ia te ai ea mala? e ia te ai misa? e ia te ai le atuatuvale? e o ai ea manunua fua? e la te ai ea mata mumu?

verses.en: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
verses.sm: O e ua faatuai i le uaina; o e o atue saili i le uaina filogia.

verses.en: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
verses.sm: Aua e te vaai i le uaina pe a múmú mai; pea pupula mai i le ipu, e alualu saʻo ifo ia.

verses.en: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
verses.sm: E mulimuli ane e feú ia, pei se gata; e pei o le gata uogo lona tui;

verses.en: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
verses.sm: e vaai ou mata i fafine ese; e tautala foi lou loto i mea faapiopio.

verses.en: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
verses.sm: E tusa lava oe ma le ua taoto i totonu o le sami; e tusa foi ma le ua taoto i le tumutumu o le fana.

verses.en: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
verses.sm: E te faapea, Na latou fasia aʻu, a ou te lei tiga ai; na latou tuíia au, a ou te lei lagona; pe a afu ala, ona ou toe sailia lea. e
